queries.sql: SELECT CAST(p.id AS CHAR) id, CAST(p.version AS CHAR) version, p.data_kind dataKind, p.name, p.status, p.priority, p.signal, c.name customer, odm.name odmFactory, pl.name productLine, a.name app, g.name projectGroup, DATE_FORMAT(p.proposed_on,'%Y-%m-%d') proposalDate, DATE_FORMAT(p.current_due_date,'%Y-%m-%d') dueDate, p.market_expectation marketExpectation, p.status_description statusDesc, p.manual_delayed manualDelayed, p.maintenance_enabled maintenanceEnabled, p.updated_at updatedAt,COALESCE((SELECT MIN(s.stage_code) FROM project_stages s WHERE s.project_id=p.id AND s.state<>'completed'), IF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM project_stages s WHERE s.project_id=p.id)=7,'completed','unconfigured')) stage,ELT(1+(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM project_stages s WHERE s.project_id=p.id AND s.state='completed'),0,5,10,20,60,80,90,100) progress FROM projects p LEFT JOIN customers c ON c.id=p.customer_id LEFT JOIN customers odm ON odm.id=p.odm_customer_id LEFT JOIN product_lines pl ON pl.id=p.product_line_id LEFT JOIN apps a ON a.id=p.app_id LEFT JOIN project_groups g ON g.id=p.group_id WHERE c.name=? ORDER BY p.id DESC LIMIT ? OFFSET ?

SELECT DISTINCT r.name value FROM projects p LEFT JOIN customers c ON c.id=p.customer_id LEFT JOIN customers odm ON odm.id=p.odm_customer_id LEFT JOIN product_lines pl ON pl.id=p.product_line_id LEFT JOIN apps a ON a.id=p.app_id LEFT JOIN project_groups g ON g.id=p.group_id JOIN project_tags l ON l.project_id=p.id JOIN tags r ON r.id=l.tag_id ORDER BY value

GROUP BY value

SELECT DISTINCT r.name value FROM projects p LEFT JOIN customers c ON c.id=p.customer_id LEFT JOIN customers odm ON odm.id=p.odm_customer_id LEFT JOIN product_lines pl ON pl.id=p.product_line_id LEFT JOIN apps a ON a.id=p.app_id LEFT JOIN project_groups g ON g.id=p.group_id JOIN project_people l ON l.project_id=p.id JOIN engineers r ON r.id=l.engineer_id ORDER BY value
